tagline.zh: 驾驶哨车守住信标，把一波波掠夺车队挡在砖墙之外。
tagline.en: Drive a sentinel rover, hold the beacon, and keep the raider columns outside the bricks.

desc.en: Finish a run, win or lose.

desc.zh: 击毁第三防区的首领「碾城者」。
desc.en: Destroy the Rampart Crusher, the boss of sector three.

desc.zh: 通关，且信标一次都没有被击中。
desc.en: Clear the game without the beacon taking a single hit.

desc.zh: 一局里亲手砌下 12 块砖。
desc.en: Lay 12 bricks yourself in one run.
Clear the game with two players.

how.zh: 掠夺车队从战场上方的三个闸口一波波开进来，目标是场地底部的信标。击毁本防区的全部敌车即可过关，第三和第六防区最后还有首领。砖墙能被炮弹打碎，钢板要升到三级火力才打得穿，水面车辆过不去，树丛只遮挡视线。你也可以在车头前砌一块砖。闪金光的敌车被击毁后会留下补给。守住六个防区即通关；信标完整度归零，或所有玩家的哨车耗尽，则失败。
how.en: Raider columns roll in through three gates at the top of the field and head for the beacon at the bottom. Destroy every raider of a sector to clear it; sectors three and six end with a boss. Shells break brick, plate only gives way to level-three firepower, vehicles cannot cross water, and thickets only hide what is under them. You can also lay a brick in front of your rover. A raider that glints gold leaves a supply chip when destroyed. Hold all six sectors to clear the game; it is lost when the beacon's integrity reaches zero or every player is out of rovers.

note.zh: 决定哨车数量、信标完整度，以及敌车开炮的频率。
note.en: Sets how many rovers you have, the beacon's integrity, and how often raiders fire.
